title: More CT and X-ray: pediatric organ atlas, RICORD radiographs, more chest pairs
description: 21 patients not used in any other pack: four pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis / abdomen-pelvis CTs (ages 1-15 y) with expert contours of up to 29 structures (atlas layer); six COVID-19-positive adult chest radiographs (MIDRC-RICORD-1C) with per-reader study-level labels; four COVID-19-AR same-day radiograph + axial CT pairs; four LIDC-IDRI nodule CTs with multi-reader outlines plus radiographs (interval unknown); three more LCTSC thoracic planning CTs with RT organ-at-risk contours.
